build_prepare_data_loader: build a distributed data loader by wrapping a PyTorch DataLoader with prepare_data_loader for multi-GPU training
create_skip_first_batches: create a data loader wrapper that skips the first N batches using skip_first_batches for checkpoint resume
create_seedable_random_sampler: create a reproducible random sampler with SeedableRandomSampler that resets its seed per epoch for distributed training
build_data_loader_shard: build a sharded data loader with DataLoaderShard that yields a portion of batches for each process in distributed training
build_data_loader_dispatcher: build a dispatcher data loader with DataLoaderDispatcher that fetches and broadcasts batches from process 0 to all processes
